tool.help:
.. class:: infomark
**What it does**
CellJourney is an interactive web-based visualization tool for single-cell RNA sequencing data. Once launched, you can interactively explore:
- Cell trajectory inference and pseudotime visualization - RNA velocity stream plots - Dimensionality-reduced embeddings (UMAP, t-SNE, PCA, etc.) - Gene expression coloring - Cluster and cell-type annotations
All visualization parameters are configured **inside the application** - no need to set them here.
-----
**Input**
A preprocessed **AnnData (.h5ad, .h5mu, .csv)** file from your Galaxy history. Recommended contents:
- ``adata.obsm['X_umap']`` - 2D embedding for visualization - ``adata.obs['leiden']`` - cluster labels (or any categorical annotation) - ``adata.obsm['velocity_umap']`` - RNA velocity vectors (optional, from scVelo) - ``adata.obs['dpt_pseudotime']`` - pseudotime values (optional)
